title: Doll & Smith v. A. & S. Sanitary Dairy
shortTitle: Doll & Smith v. A. & S. Sanitary Dairy
summary: Preparing to fill an order did not on the facts described amount to acceptance.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

Incurring preparatory costs, including a factory arrangement and an agent’s commission, did not alone establish an accepted order before cancellation. The note explicitly asks for comparison with Ever-Tite. The offer’s invited act is part of that distinction.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 235. Open assigned page 235.
